title: A2UI (Agent to UI) Client-to-Server Event Schema
description:
Describes a JSON payload for a client-to-server event message. A message MUST contain exactly one of: userAction or error.

A2UI v0.8 has no client→server message that mutates the data model. Optimistic / local writes are a renderer extension, not a fourth on-wire type. When a component's action.context (from surfaceUpdate) contains reserved __localUpdate* keys, the renderer MUST simulate a dataModelUpdate by calling SDK updateModel in its action trigger, then emit a normal userAction. Those reserved keys MUST be stripped from the emitted context so this schema stays unchanged on the wire.

userAction.description: Reports a user-initiated action from a component. Emitted after any renderer-local updateModel simulation.

name.description: The name of the action, taken from the component's action.name property.

surfaceId.description: The id of the surface where the event originated.

sourceComponentId.description: The id of the component that triggered the event.

timestamp.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

context.description: Resolved key-value pairs from the component's action.context. Renderer-reserved keys (__localUpdatePath, __localUpdateString, __localUpdateNumber, __localUpdateBoolean, __openLinkUrl, __openLinkTarget) are applied locally and MUST NOT appear here.

error.description: Reports a client-side error. The content is flexible.

rendererLocalUpdateContext.title: Renderer-local updateModel simulation (non-normative)
rendererLocalUpdateContext.description:
These keys may appear on a component action.context in surfaceUpdate. They are not part of the on-wire userAction. The a2ui-react action trigger reads them, calls updateModel(surfaceId, path, value), then dispatches userAction with the keys stripped.

- __localUpdatePath (string): dataModel path to write, e.g. /message.
- __localUpdateString | __localUpdateNumber | __localUpdateBoolean: exactly one typed value to write.

rendererLocalOpenLinkContext.title: Renderer-local openLink (non-normative)
rendererLocalOpenLinkContext.description:
These keys may appear on a component action.context in surfaceUpdate. They are not part of the on-wire userAction. The a2ui-react action trigger opens http(s) URLs with window.open (noopener,noreferrer). Action names openLink and open_link also accept a `url` / `href` context entry. javascript: and other non-http(s) URLs MUST be ignored.

- __openLinkUrl (string): absolute http or https URL.
- __openLinkTarget (string, optional): window name, default _blank.
